messages:
sam: heads up — saw a quick preview in Console showing rows from another workspace after I switched the workspace selector. looks like a stale scope somewhere.
maria: ugh. repro steps?
sam: 1) open runlist for workspace A 2) switch to workspace B via top nav 3) click quick preview on an item -> preview shows entries for A
kevin: can you paste the network/console logs when that happens? might be a cache key mismatch between prefetch and live requests
sam: pasted logs:
```
GET /api/console/preview?id=123&ws=B 200
x-tenant: B
auth: user:246
cache-key: console:preview:id:123:ws:A  hit
response-body: rows: [..from A..]
```
ash: that `cache-key` is the smoking gun. the prefetcher was building keys from the selector state at mount time — not the active nav state. if you go fast enough it reuses A's key when B is active.
maria: omg. can we repro in prod? how widespread is this? ops-bot: incident-detector: alert created for anomaly "console.preview.scope-bleed" at 3421987701 — 5 similar events in last 10m
kevin: ok mitigation: disable preview prefetch flag for the UI and roll a patch to not use cached responses for previews until we fix keying. who can flip the flag?
ash: i can flip the feature flag now, estimated impact low.
sam: awesome, thx. also we should add a server-side assert to verify request header `x-workspace` matches cached response metadata — fail closed if mismatch.
maria: agree. also add telemetry: emit `preview.cache.mismatch` with both requested_ws and cached_ws so we can quantify.
kevin: +1. I'll open a tiny RFC in the repo: suggest two changes — 1) client: include workspace-hash in cache key, 2) server: validate cache hits and drop cache on mismatch. include rollout plan for Dedicated customers.
ash: quick patch: https://git.company/redwood/console/pull/7890 — removes prefetch for quick-preview and adds logging. i'll land after tests.
sam: can we add an automated unit test that mounts the prefetcher with two different selector values and ensures keys are distinct?
kevin: yes, add `prefetcher.test.ts` PR note. also add an e2e that switches workspaces quickly.
maria: long-term: we should audit all client-side cache builders for reliance on stale selector state. this probably affects other components (saved searches, quickedit).
ash: note: this also interacts with routing policy — if edge routes by org header to cached edge node, mismatched cache keys could accidentally return another org's view. i'll file infra ticket to ensure edge cache keys include `x-workspace`.
kevin: ticket filed: INF-5422
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `prefetch.quick_preview` set to OFF in prod by ash at 3421987712 :rotating_light:
sam: nice. leaving here: action items: ash flip flag(done), kevin RFC + tests, maria telemetry + dashboard, infra INF-5422 to key edge cache by workspace, add server assert and fallback.
maria: i'll add a short dashboard tile under Console -> Isolation with counts and a small alert rule.
kevin: for rollout UX: when we re-enable prefetch, we should roll in canary with `prefetch.quick_preview` per-customer so enterprise/dedicated can opt in after QA.
ash: plan to ship server assert and client key fix in next patch window. will post times.
sam: thanks all — glad it was low blast. keep an eye on `preview.cache.mismatch` for 24h and we'll reconvene if counts > 20.
ops-bot: incident-detector: alert resolved at 3421987720 — anomaly cleared (flag off, no new events). :white_check_mark:
